title: An illusionist global workspace and AST are one theory

statements.text: Global workspace theory lacks an account of why people claim experience. Adding a model of the workspace supplies one, and since attentional enhancement is what lifts information into the workspace, a model of the workspace is a model of attention.

sources.quote: i-GW and AST are really just different versions of the same theory
Suppose that in addition to having a global workspace, Bob’s brain also constructs a model of its own global workspace.
